import unittest
import pytest
from conftest import trace


class ExpectedSetupError(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        raise ValueError("expectedFailure-does-not-cover-setUp")

    @unittest.expectedFailure
    def test_body(self):
        self.fail("must-not-run")


class ExpectedTeardownError(unittest.TestCase):
    def tearDown(self):
        raise ValueError("expectedFailure-does-not-cover-tearDown")

    @unittest.expectedFailure
    def test_body(self):
        self.fail("expected-body-failure-before-teardown-error")


class ParametrizedMethod(unittest.TestCase):
    @pytest.mark.parametrize("number", [1, 2])
    def test_parameter(self, number):
        trace("must-not-inject-parametrize", number=number)
